name: duplicate references are preserved and base updates propagate eagerly
input: a formula that references one base key twice
test:
store = KeyStore()
store.set_value('a', 2)
store.set_value('b', 3)
store.set_sum('total', ['a', 'a', 'b'])
assert store.get_value('total') == 7
store.set_value('a', 4)
assert store.get_value('total') == 11

name: formula replacement and conversion back to a base detach old edges
input: a formula is redefined then replaced by a base value
test:
store = KeyStore()
store.set_value('a', 1)
store.set_value('b', 2)
store.set_sum('total', ['a'])
store.set_sum('total', ['b'])
store.set_value('a', 9)
assert store.get_value('total') == 2
store.set_value('total', 7)
store.set_value('b', 11)
assert store.get_value('total') == 7
store.set_sum('total', ['b'])
assert store.get_value('total') == 11

name: direct indirect and rejected replacement cycles leave state unchanged
input: an existing formula graph followed by invalid cycles
test:
store = KeyStore()
for key, value in (('a', 1), ('b', 2), ('c', 3)):
    store.set_value(key, value)
store.set_sum('a', ['b'])
try:
    store.set_sum('b', ['a'])
    raise AssertionError('expected ValueError')
except ValueError:
    pass
assert store.get_value('b') == 2
store.set_sum('b', ['c'])
try:
    store.set_sum('c', ['a'])
    raise AssertionError('expected ValueError')
except ValueError:
    pass
store.set_value('c', 8)
assert store.get_value('b') == 8
assert store.get_value('a') == 8
store.set_sum('a', ['b'])
assert store.get_value('a') == 8

name: unknown references and keys fail without creating partial state
input: missing inputs and a failed formula definition
